fact: The data protection commission (CDP) says it is working with the Direction de l'automatisation des fichiers (DAF) on integrating civil status and identity, with two options (one integrated system or interoperability) reported to the authorities for decision.
RTS reports that ANEC (civil status agency) and DAF (identity file directorate) signed an interoperability protocol to exchange civil-status and biometric identity data.

The ANEC presentation of May 2025 shows NEKKAL's civil-status information system exchanging with the identity directorate, health (electronic notification of births and deaths), the statistics agency and the electoral file, with online identity verification.
The pilot of the PINS X-Road platform interconnects the civil status databases and the national identity card system with the RNU and SIGICMU, per the communications directorate of the ministry.
